Current CoverageEligibilityResponse conformance source, examples, and search parameters all use requestor. The tightly related PaymentReconciliation requestProvider rename, FHIR-17996, is already represented on the combined branch by commit 400052646c577f0d5221d98baf2ef503dec66f1a. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying discussion.
